1.3 databases and accessing them

# access airlines database

# access wai database

con_wai <- DBI::dbConnect(
  RMariaDB::MariaDB(),
  dbname = "wai",
  host = "scidb.smith.edu",
  user = "waiuser",
  password = "smith_waiDB")
